destinationFolder.description: Choose an existing folder with Browse, or edit the absolute path manually. The path is on the machine running Stash.

collisionPolicy.description: rename (default), skip, or overwrite. Rename adds a numeric suffix and never replaces an existing file.

createSceneFolders.displayName: Create a folder for each item
createSceneFolders.description: Put scenes and marker clips in scene-title folders, and images in image-title folders. Disabled by default.

dryRun.description: Report what would be copied without writing any files. Disabled by default.

maxCopySpeedMBps.description: Limit disk usage so Stash stays responsive. Defaults to 20 MiB/s. Set to 0 for unlimited speed.
